reasoning: Both attempts build a hold-counted cache that loads the picker's open sound before the picker opens. A plays a clone of the cached Sound for each cue, so rapid cues overlap, and it passes all three checks. B restarts the one shared Sound, so rapid clicks cut each other off. B also silently drops cues that aren't loaded within 0.1 s, which changes when cues are heard, and it fails StyLua on its own code.

criteria.criterion: Cues play from a pre-created, loaded Sound kept while the UI can play it
criteria.note: `UiSounds.hold` creates one cached Sound per id in `UiSoundCache`, and `play` clones it. The Ended destroy that the check matched applies only to the clone.

criteria.criterion: Picker sounds held around build mode only
criteria.note: `app()` holds PickerOpen before the picker opens, and `blockPicker` holds PickerClose through cleanup with a deferred release. PickerOpen stays held for the HUD's whole life.

criteria.criterion: Shared sound has one ref-counted copy
criteria.note: `holdCounts` counts the holds, the last release destroys the Sound one frame later after rechecking the count, and a second release does nothing.

criteria.criterion: Rapid cues each play without piling up
criteria.note: Every cue plays its own clone, which is destroyed on `Ended:Once`.
The note explains the cause, describes the `UiSoundCache` contents with build mode on and off, and gives a ChildAdded snippet that prints `IsLoaded` per cue. It mentions a phone emulator.
All cues play at the same moments as before, and luau-lsp, selene and StyLua all pass.

criteria.criterion: Cues play from a pre-created, loaded Sound kept while the UI can play it
criteria.note: `retain` creates one Sound per id, calls PreloadAsync on that instance, and `play` restarts it.

criteria.criterion: Picker sounds held around build mode only
criteria.note: The Build button uses Click and PickerOpen ahead of time. The picker retains PickerClose and releases it after playing, and `destroyWhenQuiet` waits for `Ended`.

criteria.criterion: Shared sound has one ref-counted copy
criteria.note: `entry.refs` counts holds, so Click held by both the button and the picker is freed only on the last release.

criteria.criterion: Rapid cues each play without piling up
criteria.note: `play` sets `TimePosition = 0` on the one shared Sound, so rapid clicks cut each other off instead of each playing.
Covers the cache, SoundService instances and phone testing well, but only checks IsLoaded before the press, not when each cue plays.
StyLua fails on its own `warn` line, and cues not loaded within 0.1 s are now dropped, which changes when cues are heard.

strengths: Hold-counted shared cache, with play cloning the cached Sound so rapid cues overlap
Deferred release keeps the close cue and quick re-holds safe
Clear note with a way to check IsLoaded at each cue
weaknesses: Click and PickerOpen are held for the HUD's whole life rather than per screen
Falls back to the late-playing behaviour if a cue isn't held

strengths: Solid hold counting, with the use/retain API tied to Vide scopes
The release waits for a playing cue to end
weaknesses: Restarting one shared Sound truncates rapid cues
Drops cues that load late, so they are no longer always heard
StyLua check fails on its own code
